title: Space/set addCategories rejects entries without id
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 (1e33ec7) Space/set addCategories: 'Each entry: `name` (String), optional `position` (UnsignedInt) and `channelIds` (String[]). Server assigns ULIDs.' The server parses each entry as Category and returns invalidProperties 'addCategories[0]: failed to parse entry: missing field `id`'. jmap-chat-client SpaceAddCategoryInput (draft-conformant) sends no id, so client addCategories never works against the reference server. Found while writing the wire test for JMAP-yt1w.6. Once this is fixed, extend crate-jmap-testjig/tests/chat_client_wire.rs with an addCategories-moves-channel test.
notes: Done in 3f21654b: tests space_set_category_add_without_id_is_accepted, space_add_categories_moves_channel_into_new_category; changed existing tests: none
